chapterTitle: Principle 9: Experimentation: Explore outside your comfort zone
frozenSupport: Experimentation pushes beyond default methods and comfort-zone habits.
safeExtensions: Default methods can feel natural enough that the learner stops questioning them.
Testing alternatives can reveal better fit, stronger results, or assumptions hidden by familiarity.
Experimentation should remain tied to the real skill instead of becoming random novelty.
Useful discomfort matters when it exposes options the comfort-zone method would miss.
forbiddenDrift: External innovation frameworks or startup language.
Claims that novelty is automatically superior.
Mystique around experimentation as personality rather than method.
